_comment: Weekly banner illustrations for recurring newsletter sections. Generate via Canva (see README -- Higgsfield is the documented fallback only, credits are usually near zero) and save under assets/banners/<slug>/<date>.png; never overwrites a prior week's image. Edit 'prompt' per section to steer content; 'style' is shared so all three read as one cohesive set. 2026-10-05: switched from a soft muted watercolor style to a brighter, more realistic one per Max's direction to keep evolving the newsletter's feel week to week -- don't revert to 'soft watercolor/muted palette' wording without being asked. Generated wide (aspect_ratio, the widest the model supports) then center-cropped down to crop_aspect_ratio -- a skinny letterbox banner, about 4 text-lines tall, sized to roughly one language column's width (display_max_width_px) since the .both.html draft shows English and Serbian side by side and the banner should not span both.
style: Bright, vivid, realistic illustration with crisp detail and natural warm daylight, rich saturated palette of navy blue, golden amber, and deep red accents, lively and cheerful energy, warm expressive realistic faces, evocative of a close-knit parish community having a genuinely good time together. Compose the main subjects within a horizontal band across the vertical middle third of the frame, since the image will be cropped into a very wide, short letterbox strip. No text, no legible words or letters, no logos.
negative_prompt: text, letters, words, captions, watermark, logo, muted desaturated colors, flat lighting, distorted hands, clip art, cartoon outlines, modern branding

sections.prompt: A small church school scene: a teacher with her hair uncovered (no headscarf or head covering of any kind) and young children seated around a low wooden table with open picture-books, a small icon corner glowing warmly in the background, warm autumn light through a tall arched window, golden and navy tones, joyful and unhurried mood. No candles anywhere in the scene.

A Serbian language classroom scene: a woman in her 50s to 60s and a child reading together from an open book, a wooden desk, a small Serbian tricolor ribbon and a tamburica resting nearby, warm cream and gold tones, tender intergenerational mood.

A young-adults gathering scene: friends around a table with coffee cups and an open board game, bright natural daylight streaming through tall windows, a hint of a sunny church courtyard visible through a window behind them, relaxed navy and green accents, cheerful upbeat daytime mood, easy conversation.
